key_concepts: Objects seen in the sky can be natural or human-made.
Natural sky objects include the Sun, Moon, stars, planets, clouds, and birds.
Human-made sky objects include planes, kites, balloons, and helicopters.
Sky objects can be living or non-living; birds are living, while the Sun, Moon, stars, clo
Daytime is when the Sun is in the sky and people can see clearly and do activities outside
Natural non-living objects seen in the daytime include the Sun and cumulus, cirrus, and ni
The Sun is bright, very hot, and round.
Nighttime is when the Sun goes down and the sky gets dark.
Natural non-living objects seen at night include the Moon, stars, and planets.
The Moon is round, bright, shines at night, and sometimes appears full or small.
Stars twinkle, meaning they shine with a small light that goes on and off quickly.
Natural objects in the sky can be described by their color, shape, size, and appearance.
